Frequently asked questions

Still unsure? Call the office — we would rather answer than have you guess.

What courses does DS Science Academy offer?
NEET-UG, IIT-JEE (Main + Advanced), Foundation for Class 6–10, and board preparation for CBSE and RBSE.
When do the new batches start?
Class 11 and 12 batches begin in the first week of August. Dropper batches start in late June. Foundation batches start in April.
Is there a scholarship test?
Yes. The annual scholarship test is held in August and offers up to a 100% fee waiver. Registration is free.
How big are the batches?
Every batch is capped at 40 students, so each student gets individual attention.
Are the fees payable in instalments?
Yes. Fees can be paid in two or three instalments. Talk to the front office for the schedule.
Do you provide hostel facility?
We do not run a hostel ourselves, but we help outstation families find vetted hostels and PGs close to the campus.

About this programme

The NEET-UG programme at DS Science Academy runs for two years, starting in Class 11 and finishing with a full revision cycle before the exam. Droppers join a separate, faster batch that covers the same ground in one year.

Teaching stays anchored to NCERT because that is what the paper is built on. Physics gets a problem a day from the first week, Chemistry is split into three habits — Inorganic by revision, Organic by mechanism, Physical by practice — and Biology is read straight from the book, line by line, until nothing in it is unfamiliar.

Every Sunday there is a full test on the NTA pattern with a real OMR sheet. The following Tuesday that paper is discussed in class, question by question. A test nobody reviews is just a number, so we do not leave it at that.

Questions about this course

Can I join the Class 12 batch directly?
Yes. Students joining in Class 12 sit a short placement test so we know where to begin, and get extra Class 11 revision classes on Sundays for the first two months.
What is the difference between the regular and dropper batch?
The dropper batch covers the full two-year syllabus in one year at a faster pace, runs six hours a day, and has a full test every week instead of every fortnight.
Is study material charged separately?
No. Printed modules, daily practice sheets and the 10-year PYQ book are all included in the fee shown above.
Can I attend a class before deciding?
Yes — book a free demo class. Sit through a full session with the batch you are considering, then decide.

Why this matters more than it sounds

Coaching in small towns has one recurring problem: teachers leave mid-session. Here is how we avoid it.

🔁

Same teacher, start to finish

The teacher who begins your batch in August is the one who takes the last revision class before the exam. No mid-year swaps.

🏠

Local, not flown in

Our faculty live in Gangapur City. They are not visiting from Kota for three days a week and disappearing for the rest.

📋

They write our papers

Every test is set by the same teachers who teach the chapter — not bought from a paper vendor who never met your batch.

💬

They sit at the doubt counter

The doubt counter is staffed by the subject teachers themselves, not by junior assistants.

📞

Parents can reach them

At the monthly parent meeting you speak to the actual subject teacher, not only to the office.

🎓

Every one is a post-graduate

Minimum M.Sc. in the subject they teach. Several have NET or a doctorate.

Common questions before visiting

If yours is not here, just call — we would rather answer than have you guess.

Do I need an appointment to visit?
No. Walk in any day between 9 am and 7 pm, Monday to Saturday. If you want a specific teacher present, call ahead so we can check their class timing.
Can I see a class before taking admission?
Yes. Book a free demo class and sit through a full session with the batch you are considering. Parents are welcome to sit in as well.
What should I bring for admission?
Last school marksheet, Aadhaar card, two passport photographs and the first fee instalment. Nothing else is needed on day one.
Is the office open on Sunday?
Sunday is test day. Classes run in the morning and the office stays open until 2 pm, but the admissions counsellor may not always be available — call first.
Do you have branches in other towns?
Right now there is one campus, in Gangapur City. Students from Sawai Madhopur, Karauli and nearby villages travel in daily, and we help outstation families find hostels close by.

Admission questions

Is there an entrance test to get admission?
No. Admission is open to any student in the eligible class. The scholarship test in August is separate and completely optional — it only decides your fee waiver, not whether you get in.
Can I join after the batch has started?
Up to about four weeks after the start, yes — and we arrange extra classes to cover what you missed. Beyond that we usually suggest waiting for the next batch rather than starting behind.
What if I take admission and then want to leave?
Refunds follow our published refund rules, which are given to you in writing at admission. Talk to the office; the deduction schedule is explained there clearly.
Do you charge separately for study material or tests?
No. Printed modules, daily practice sheets, the previous-year question book and every test are included in the fee shown above.
Can fees be paid online?
Yes — UPI, card or bank transfer at the office, and online payment from this website. Every payment gets a receipt the same day.
My child is weak in one subject. Will that be a problem?
No, and it is worth telling us at admission. Weak subjects get extra doubt-counter time from the start rather than being noticed in December.

How we do this

Video when the teacher is free

Print-friendly

Kept year on year

Questions about DSAT

Do I have to join DS Science Academy if I appear?
No. The test is free and carries no obligation. Many students sit it just to see where they stand. If you decide not to join, nothing is charged and nothing is held against you.
Is there really no registration fee?
None. Not for the form, not for the hall ticket, not for the result. If anyone asks you for money to register for DSAT, tell the office immediately.
What if I score badly?
Everyone who appears gets at least a 10% waiver. A low score does not stop you taking admission — it only tells us which subject needs extra doubt-counter time from day one.
Is the syllabus from my current class or the next one?
From the class you have just finished. A student entering Class 11 is tested on Class 10 syllabus. Nothing you have not already studied will appear.
Can I get a sample paper?
Yes. Last year's paper with the answer key is on the Downloads page, and we send a sample paper along with your registration confirmation.
How long is the waiver valid?
You must take admission by 31 August 2026 to use it. After that the waiver lapses and you would need to sit the test again next year.
Can I appear more than once?
The test is held once a year, so once per year. If you sat it last year, your earlier waiver does not carry forward — the new score replaces it.

Home  ›  About Us

Twelve years in one town

DS Science Academy has never opened a second branch, never franchised the name, and never taught a batch we could not personally supervise. Everything we have built is on one street in Gangapur City.

2014Founded
2,500+Students today
184Selections
24Faculty

How it started

In 2014 there was no serious NEET or JEE coaching in Gangapur City. Families who could afford it sent their children to Kota or Sikar at fifteen. Families who could not simply gave up on the idea — a bright student from a village near Bamanwas had no realistic path to a medical seat.

DS Science Academy started in two rented rooms with nineteen students and three teachers. The idea was narrow and stubborn: prepare students for these exams here, at a fee families in this district could actually pay, without pretending that distance from Kota was an excuse for a weaker result.

The first NEET selection came in 2016. The first AIR under a thousand took until 2022. Nothing about it was quick, and we have never claimed otherwise.

Today there are 2,500 students and twenty-four teachers, still in one building, still on the same street. We have turned down every franchise offer we have received, because the moment we cannot walk into a classroom and see what is happening in it, none of this works.

From the founder

FOUNDER PHOTO
"

My father taught in a government school for thirty-one years. He used to say that the difference between a child who makes it and one who does not is almost never talent — it is whether somebody was paying attention on the day they got stuck.

That is the whole idea here. We keep batches at forty because a teacher can notice forty faces. We discuss every test the same week because a mistake you do not revisit is a mistake you will repeat in the exam. We keep the doubt counter open all day because doubts do not arrive on schedule.

We are not the biggest institute, and in Gangapur City we do not need to be. We need to be the one that a parent can walk into on a Tuesday afternoon and get a straight answer about their child.

Devendra Singh Founder & Director · DS Science Academy

How we got here

Twelve years, told honestly — including the years nothing much happened.

2014

Two rooms, nineteen students

Started above a shop near the bus stand with three teachers and a blackboard. Fees were ₹800 a month.

2016

First NEET selection

One student, one government medical seat. It changed how the town spoke about us — and how we spoke about ourselves.

2018

Moved to the current building

Twelve classrooms, a library and a proper test hall. Foundation batches for Class 6–10 started the same year.

2020

The year we nearly closed

Classes stopped for eleven months. We taught on phones, kept every teacher on salary, and did not raise fees when we reopened. We came out of it smaller and slower — and with families who stayed.

2022

First AIR under a thousand

Eight years in. The computer lab for CBT mocks was set up the same year, after watching students struggle with the screen rather than the paper.

2025

Our best result so far

AIR 342 in NEET, AIR 1,208 in JEE Advanced, and 58 selections in one year — more than the first four years put together.

2026

Still one building

2,500 students, 24 teachers, one campus. The evening batch for school-going students starts this August.

What we actually believe

Not a mission statement. Just the four things we argue about internally and keep coming back to.

👁️
Attention beats talent

Most students do not fail because they cannot do it. They fail because nobody noticed the week they fell behind. Forty per batch exists for this reason alone.

🔁
A test without a review is a waste

Anyone can set a paper. Discussing all 180 questions the same week is the hard, boring part — and it is the part that moves scores.

💬
Say the difficult thing early

If a student is in the wrong batch, or should repeat a year, we say so in August. Telling a family in March is not kindness.

🏠
Stay where you can be seen

One campus, one town. Every franchise offer has been declined for the same reason — we would stop being able to check.

Things worth knowing

Fee rules, written down plainly so there are no surprises later.

🧾

Receipt every single time

Whether you pay online or in cash at the counter, a receipt is issued the same day — on WhatsApp and on paper if you ask.

📅

Ten days of grace

A late fee of ₹200 applies only after ten days past the due date. Tell us in advance if there is a genuine problem and it is usually waived.

💰

No convenience charge

What you see is what you pay. We absorb the gateway charge rather than adding it to your bill.

🚫

Nobody is stopped from class

A pending instalment does not get a student sent home. The office speaks to the parent instead.

🎓

Waivers apply automatically

Scholarship and sibling discounts are already worked into the amounts shown above. Nothing to claim separately.

↩️

Refunds are written down

The deduction schedule is given to you at admission and published on the Refund Rules page. No case-by-case decisions.

Payment questions

Is it safe to pay online?
Payments go through a secure gateway; we never see or store your card details. If you would rather not pay online, the fee counter accepts cash, card and UPI during office hours.
I paid but no receipt came. What now?
Receipts usually arrive within a minute. If it has been longer than an hour, send the payment screenshot to the office on WhatsApp at +91 99999 99998 and they will issue it manually the same day.
Can I change my instalment plan mid-session?
Yes. Talk to the office — moving from three instalments to two, or the other way, is done in a minute and the schedule is reissued.
The amount shown looks wrong.
Do not pay it. Call the office on +91 99999 99998 first. Scholarship waivers and sibling discounts sometimes take a day to reflect after they are approved.
Can somebody else pay on my behalf?
Yes. Anyone can pay using the student ID as the reference — a relative, an employer, anyone. The receipt still goes to the registered parent number.

Questions people actually ask

Showing 30 questions

ADMISSIONS

Is there an entrance test to get admission?
No. Admission is open to any student in the eligible class. The DSAT scholarship test in August is separate and completely optional — it only decides your fee waiver, not whether you get in.
What documents do I need to bring?
Last school marksheet, the student's Aadhaar card, a parent's Aadhaar card, two passport photographs and the first fee instalment. If something is missing, come anyway — we can start the process and you bring the rest within a week.
Can I join after the batch has started?
Up to about four weeks after the start, yes, and we arrange extra classes to cover what you missed. Beyond that we usually suggest waiting for the next batch rather than starting behind.
Do I need an appointment to visit?
No. Walk in any day between 9 am and 7 pm, Monday to Saturday. If you want a specific teacher present, call ahead so we can check their class timing.
Can I attend a class before deciding?
Yes — book a free demo class. Sit through a full session with the batch you are considering. Parents are welcome to sit in as well. There is no fee and no obligation afterwards.
Do you charge a donation or capitation fee?
No. The fee published on the website is the entire amount. If anyone asks you for money beyond it, tell the Director directly.

FEES & PAYMENT

Can fees be paid in instalments?
Yes — two or three instalments for most courses. The full schedule with dates and amounts is on the Admissions page, and you can switch plans mid-session by telling the office.
Is study material charged separately?
No. Printed modules, daily practice sheets, the ten-year previous-year book and every test are included in the fee. There are no paid add-ons.
Can I pay online?
Yes — UPI, card or bank transfer from the Pay Fees page, or cash and card at the office counter. The receipt reaches your WhatsApp the same minute either way.
What happens if I miss an instalment date?
There are ten days of grace. A late fee of ₹200 applies after that, and it is usually waived if you tell us in advance that there is a genuine problem. A student is never sent home over a pending instalment.
Is there a sibling discount?
Yes — 10% off the second admission when two children from one family study here. It stacks with any scholarship waiver.
What if I take admission and then want to leave?
Refunds follow the published refund rules, which are given to you in writing at admission. The deduction depends on how much of the session has passed — there are no case-by-case decisions.

COURSES & BATCHES

What courses do you offer?
NEET-UG, IIT-JEE (Main + Advanced), Foundation for Class 6 to 10, and board preparation for CBSE and RBSE.
When do the new batches start?
Class 11 and 12 batches begin in the first week of August. Dropper batches start in late June. Foundation batches start in April. The evening batch for school-going students starts 10 August.
How big are the batches?
Every batch is capped at 40 students. This is the one rule we do not bend, even when a batch is in demand.
What is the difference between the regular and dropper batch?
The dropper batch covers the full two-year syllabus in one year at a faster pace, runs six hours a day, and has a full test every week instead of every fortnight.
I am in school. Can I still attend?
Yes — the evening batch runs 4 pm to 8 pm for exactly this. Tell us your school timing at admission and we will fit you into a batch that works.
Can I take both board and competitive preparation together?
Yes. Board Booster runs alongside the main NEET or JEE batch on weekends and evenings, so board marks do not suffer.

SCHOLARSHIP TEST (DSAT)

Is there a registration fee for DSAT?
None. Not for the form, not for the hall ticket, not for the result. If anyone asks you for money to register, tell the office immediately.
Do I have to join if I appear for the test?
No. The test is free and carries no obligation. Many students sit it just to see where they stand.
What if I score badly?
Everyone who appears gets at least a 10% waiver. A low score does not stop you taking admission — it only tells us which subject needs extra doubt-counter time from day one.
What syllabus is the test based on?
The class you have just finished. A student entering Class 11 is tested on Class 10 syllabus. Nothing you have not already studied will appear.
How long is the waiver valid?
You must take admission by 31 August to use it. After that the waiver lapses and you would need to sit the test again next year.

CAMPUS, HOSTEL & SAFETY

Do you provide hostel facility?
We do not run a hostel ourselves. We keep a list of hostels and PGs we have actually visited — separate lists for boys and girls — and we walk outstation families through it. We take no commission from any of them.
How much does a hostel or PG cost here?
Typically ₹4,000 to ₹7,000 a month including meals, depending on how many share a room.
What arrangements are there for girls?
A separate common room with a dedicated female attendant on duty through the day, clean washrooms alongside, and CCTV across the campus. Parents get the attendant's number at admission.
What if my child does not reach the campus?
The office calls home the same morning. Attendance is not something a parent finds out about a month later.
How do I reach the campus?
Two minutes' walk from Gangapur City bus stand, and about 3 km from the railway station with autos running through the day.

TEACHING & RESULTS

Will the same teacher take my batch all year?
Yes. The teacher who begins your batch in August is the one who takes the last revision class before the exam. Our faculty live in Gangapur City — they are not visiting from Kota for three days a week.
How often are tests held?
A full test every Sunday on the NTA pattern with a real OMR sheet, and the paper is discussed question by question the following Tuesday.
My child is weak in one subject. Is that a problem?
No, and it is worth telling us at admission. Weak subjects get extra doubt-counter time from the start rather than being noticed in December.
How do parents know how their child is doing?
A monthly report with attendance and test performance, on paper and on WhatsApp, plus a parent-teacher meeting on the first Sunday of every month where you meet the subject teachers directly.
Are your results verifiable?
Yes. Ask the office for the full result list with roll numbers and they will hand it over. Every name on the Results page is a student who studied in these classrooms.

Not every question has an answer on the website. Leave your number — a counsellor will call and talk it through, and if our institute isn't the right fit for your child, they'll tell you that honestly too.

Demo class questions

Is the demo really free?
Yes, completely — no charge, no card details asked, and no obligation to join afterwards.
Will it be a special class arranged just for me?
No. You sit inside the actual running batch and get the same class the enrolled students get that day — nothing is staged for visitors.
Can I book more than one demo, for different subjects?
Yes. Many families do exactly that before deciding — just mention it in the form or tell the office when you call.
What if I can't make it to the slot I booked?
Call the office and we will move you to another slot the same week — no charge, no questions asked.
How is the Live demo different from Offline?
Same class, same teacher, same length — you just join on a Google Meet / YouTube Live link from your phone or laptop instead of coming to campus. The link is sent on WhatsApp 30 minutes before the class.
Do I have to decide about admission right after the demo?
No. The counsellor explains fees and batches after class, but you are free to take a few days before deciding.

Rank predictor questions

How accurate is this predictor?
It is an estimate based on previous years' cutoff trends, not an official result. Actual ranks and college allotments depend on that year's exam difficulty, number of candidates and seat matrix.
Where do I find my percentile or CRL rank?

Does this book a seat or apply anywhere?
No. This is only an estimate to help you plan. Actual admission happens through the official counselling process — MCC/state counselling for NEET, JoSAA/CSAB for JEE.
Can I get a more detailed college list?
